children.value: > Fact From Story | a comprehensive law defining and limiting the use of AI seems as far off now as it was years ago.
> > Fact From Story | It’s not even really clear what ought to be legislatively limited, as opposed to being left to state law or expert agencies.
> > Fact From Story | The industry and technology have evolved so quickly that any rule would likely be outdated by the time it was passed.
> > Commonsense Knowledge | It is difficult to create laws for a rapidly changing industry.

> Fact From Story | Given the state of the legislature and the fact that an incredibly contentious election period is upcoming, it will be a miracle if any substantive law whatsoever is passed in the near future

> > Fact From Story | But as with all such orders, what the president can dictate without legislative support is limited, as numerous experts and stakeholders emphasized in response. | Fact From Story
> > Fact From Story | Biden’s AI EO hailed as broad, but not deep without legislation to match | Fact From Story

> > > > Fact From Story | Facing twin risks of premature action chilling innovation and dilatory action permitting abuse or exploitation, the U.S. and EU have avoided the first but due to lengthy argument and drafting processes are rolling headlong toward the second. | Fact From Story
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge | It is difficult to pass laws when the legislature is in a state of gridlock. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge | Executive orders are limited in scope without legislative action. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge | It is difficult to pass laws when the legislature is in a state of gridlock.
